svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="rc2C3n3kaGY8YtA5Bkzh"> <mxGraphModel dx="6195" dy="8056" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="3300" pageHeight="4681" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml class_diagram
title Orders Management System - Class Diagram

skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam classFontSize 13
skinparam packageStyle rectangle

' ─── Model ───────────────────────────────────────────────
package \"org.mishu.Model\" {
 class Client {
 - id : int
 - name : String
 - address : String
 - email : String
 + Client()
 + Client(id, name, email, address)
 + Client(name, email, address)
 + getId() : int
 + setId(id : int)
 + getName() : String
 + setName(name : String)
 + getAddress() : String
 + setAddress(address : String)
 + getEmail() : String
 + setEmail(email : String)
 }

 class Product {
 - id : int
 - name : String
 - price : double
 - quantity : int
 + Product()
 + Product(id, name, price, quantity)
 + Product(name, price, quantity)
 + getId() : int
 + getName() : String
 + getPrice() : double
 + getQuantity() : int
 + setId(id : int)
 + setName(name : String)
 + setPrice(price : double)
 + setQuantity(quantity : int)
 }

 class Orders {
 - id : int
 - clientId : int
 - productId : int
 - quantity : int
 + Orders()
 + Orders(id, clientId, productId, quantity)
 + Orders(clientId, productId, quantity)
 + getId() : int
 + getClientId() : int
 + getProductId() : int
 + getQuantity() : int
 + setId(id : int)
 + setClientId(clientId : int)
 + setProductId(productId : int)
 + setQuantity(quantity : int)
 }

 class Bill <<record>> {
 + id : int
 + orderId : int
 + clientId : int
 + productId : int
 + quantity : int
 + total : double
 }
}

' ─── Utils ───────────────────────────────────────────────
package \"org.mishu.Utils\" {
 class QuerySettings <<record>> {
 + all : boolean
 + useLike : boolean
 }

 package \"org.mishu.Utils.Exceptions\" {
 class DuplicateEmailException {
 + DuplicateEmailException(message : String)
 }
 class ZeroQtyOrderException {
 + ZeroQtyOrderException(message : String)
 }
 DuplicateEmailException --|> RuntimeException
 ZeroQtyOrderException --|> RuntimeException
 }
}

' ─── DataAccess ──────────────────────────────────────────
package \"org.mishu.DataAccess\" {
 class ConnectionFactory {
 - {static} DRIVER : String
 - {static} DB_URL : String
 - {static} USER : String
 - {static} PASS : String
 - {static} instance : ConnectionFactory
 - ConnectionFactory()
 + {static} getConnection() : Connection
 + {static} close(connection : Connection)
 + {static} close(statement : Statement)
 + {static} close(resultSet : ResultSet)
 - createConnection() : Connection
 }

 package \"org.mishu.DataAccess.Wrappers\" {
 class DBWrapper<T> {
 - type : Class<T>
 + DBWrapper(type : Class<T>)
 # createSelectQuery(field : String) : String
 # createSelectLikeQuery(field : String) : String
 # createObjects(rs : ResultSet) : List<T>
 + findById(id : int) : T
 + findAll() : List<T>
 + get(fieldValue, fieldName, query, settings) : List<T>
 + insert(object : T) : int
 + update(object : T)
 + delete(id : int)
 }

 class ClientDBWrapper {
 + ClientDBWrapper(type : Class<Client>)
 + findByEmail(email : String) : Client
 + findClientByName(name : String) : Client
 + findClientsByName(name : String) : List<Client>
 }

 class ProductDBWrapper {
 + ProductDBWrapper(type : Class<Product>)
 + findProductByName(name : String) : Product
 + findProductsByName(name : String) : List<Product>
 + findProductsByPrice(price : double) : List<Product>
 + findProductsByQty(qty : int) : List<Product>
 }

 class OrdersDBWrapper {
 + OrdersDBWrapper(type : Class<Orders>)
 + findByClientId(clientId : int) : List<Orders>
 + findByProductId(productId : int) : List<Orders>
 }

 class BillDBWrapper {
 + BillDBWrapper(type : Class<Bill>)
 + insertBill(orderId, clientId, productId, qty, total)
 + findByOrderId(orderId : int) : Bill
 }

 ClientDBWrapper --|> DBWrapper
 ProductDBWrapper --|> DBWrapper
 OrdersDBWrapper --|> DBWrapper
 BillDBWrapper --|> DBWrapper
 }
}

' ─── Business / Validator ────────────────────────────────
package \"org.mishu.Business\" {
 package \"org.mishu.Business.Validator\" {
 interface Validator<T> {
 + validate(t : T)
 }

 class EmailValidator {
 - EMAIL_PATTERN : String
 + validate(client : Client)
 }

 class PriceValidator {
 + validate(product : Product)
 }

 class QtyValidator {
 + validate(product : Product)
 }

 class OrderValidator {
 + validate(order : Orders)
 }

 EmailValidator ..|> Validator
 PriceValidator ..|> Validator
 QtyValidator ..|> Validator
 OrderValidator ..|> Validator
 }

 class ClientBLL {
 - emailValidator : Validator<Client>
 - dbWrapper : ClientDBWrapper
 - ordersBLL : OrdersBLL
 + ClientBLL(ordersBLL : OrdersBLL)
 + findAll() : List<Client>
 + findClientByName(name : String) : Client
 + insertClient(client : Client)
 + deleteClient(clientId : int)
 + updateClient(clientId, name, email, address)
 }

 class ProductBLL {
 - validators : List<Validator<Product>>
 - dbWrapper : ProductDBWrapper
 - ordersBLL : OrdersBLL
 + ProductBLL(ordersBLL : OrdersBLL)
 + findProductById(productId : int) : Product
 + findProductByName(name : String) : Product
 + findProductsByName(name : String) : List<Product>
 + insertProduct(product : Product)
 + findAll() : List<Product>
 + deleteProduct(productId : int)
 + updateProduct(productId, name, price, quantity)
 }

 class OrdersBLL {
 - validator : Validator<Orders>
 - dbWrapper : OrdersDBWrapper
 - productDBWrapper : ProductDBWrapper
 - clientDBWrapper : ClientDBWrapper
 - billDBWrapper : BillDBWrapper
 + OrdersBLL()
 + findOrderById(orderId : int) : Orders
 + findByClientId(clientId : int) : List<Orders>
 + findByProductId(productId : int) : List<Orders>
 + findAll() : List<Orders>
 + insertOrder(order : Orders)
 + deleteOrder(orderId : int)
 + updateOrder(orderId, clientId, productId, quantity)
 }

 ClientBLL --> ClientDBWrapper
 ClientBLL --> OrdersBLL
 ProductBLL --> ProductDBWrapper
 ProductBLL --> OrdersBLL
 OrdersBLL --> OrdersDBWrapper
 OrdersBLL --> ProductDBWrapper
 OrdersBLL --> ClientDBWrapper
 OrdersBLL --> BillDBWrapper
}

' ─── Presentation ────────────────────────────────────────
package \"org.mishu.Presentation\" {
 class MainFrame {
 - ordersBLL : OrdersBLL
 - clientBLL : ClientBLL
 - productBLL : ProductBLL
 - selectedClientId : Integer
 - selectedProductId : Integer
 + MainFrame()
 - initUI()
 - buildClientPanel() : JPanel
 - buildProductPanel() : JPanel
 - buildOrderPanel() : JPanel
 - openNewOrderFrame()
 - showBillDialog(orderId, productId, qty)
 - loadClients()
 - loadProducts()
 - reloadOrders()
 }

 MainFrame --> ClientBLL
 MainFrame --> ProductBLL
 MainFrame --> OrdersBLL
}

' ─── Entry point ─────────────────────────────────────────
class OrdersManagement {
 + {static} main(args : String[])
}
OrdersManagement --> MainFrame

@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="0v3otCO77mmnEKuoZ0zf-3"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1798" width="3305" x="80" y="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml package_diagram
title Orders Management System - Package Diagram

skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam packageFontSize 13
skinparam ArrowThickness 1.5

package \"org.mishu\" {

 package \"Presentation\" {
 [MainFrame]
 }

 package \"Business\" {
 [ClientBLL]
 [ProductBLL]
 [OrdersBLL]

 package \"Business.Validator\" {
 [Validator <<interface>>]
 [EmailValidator]
 [PriceValidator]
 [QtyValidator]
 [OrderValidator]
 }
 }

 package \"DataAccess\" {
 [ConnectionFactory]

 package \"DataAccess.Wrappers\" {
 [DBWrapper<T>]
 [ClientDBWrapper]
 [ProductDBWrapper]
 [OrdersDBWrapper]
 [BillDBWrapper]
 }
 }

 package \"Model\" {
 [Client]
 [Product]
 [Orders]
 [Bill]
 }

 package \"Utils\" {
 [QuerySettings]

 package \"Utils.Exceptions\" {
 [DuplicateEmailException]
 [ZeroQtyOrderException]
 }
 }
}

' ─── Inter-package dependencies ──────────────────────────
Presentation ..> Business : uses
Business ..> DataAccess : uses
Business ..> Model : uses
Business ..> \"Utils.Exceptions\": throws
DataAccess ..> Model : maps
DataAccess ..> Utils : uses
\"Business.Validator\" ..> Model : validates

@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="0v3otCO77mmnEKuoZ0zf-4"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1099" width="2913" x="80" y="1920" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml use_case_diagram
title Orders Management System - Use Case Diagram

left to right direction
skinparam actorStyle awesome
skinparam usecaseFontSize 12
skinparam packageStyle rectangle

actor \"User\" as U
actor \"Database\n(MySQL)\" as DB

rectangle \"Order Management System\" {

 package \"Client Management\" {
 usecase \"View All Clients\" as UC1
 usecase \"Add Client\" as UC2
 usecase \"Update Client\" as UC3
 usecase \"Delete Client\" as UC4
 usecase \"Validate Client Email\" as UC5
 usecase \"Check Duplicate Email\" as UC6
 }

 package \"Product Management\" {
 usecase \"View All Products\" as UC7
 usecase \"Add Product\" as UC8
 usecase \"Update Product\" as UC9
 usecase \"Delete Product\" as UC10
 usecase \"Validate Product Price\" as UC11
 usecase \"Validate Product Qty\" as UC12
 }

 package \"Order Management\" {
 usecase \"View Orders for Client\" as UC13
 usecase \"Place New Order\" as UC14
 usecase \"Delete Order\" as UC15
 usecase \"Validate Order Qty\" as UC16
 usecase \"Deduct Stock\" as UC17
 usecase \"Generate Bill\" as UC18
 }

 package \"Billing\" {
 usecase \"View Bill for Order\" as UC19
 }
}

' ─── User interactions ───────────────────────────────────
U --> UC1
U --> UC2
U --> UC3
U --> UC4
U --> UC7
U --> UC8
U --> UC9
U --> UC10
U --> UC13
U --> UC14
U --> UC15
U --> UC19

' ─── Include/extend relationships ────────────────────────
UC2 ..> UC5 : <<include>>
UC3 ..> UC5 : <<include>>
UC2 ..> UC6 : <<include>>
UC3 ..> UC6 : <<include>>

UC8 ..> UC11 : <<include>>
UC8 ..> UC12 : <<include>>
UC9 ..> UC11 : <<include>>
UC9 ..> UC12 : <<include>>

UC4 ..> UC13 : <<include>>\ncheck no orders

UC14 ..> UC16 : <<include>>
UC14 ..> UC17 : <<include>>
UC14 ..> UC18 : <<include>>

UC19 ..> UC18 : <<extend>>

' ─── Database interactions ───────────────────────────────
DB <.. UC1 : query
DB <.. UC2 : insert
DB <.. UC3 : update
DB <.. UC4 : delete
DB <.. UC7 : query
DB <.. UC8 : insert
DB <.. UC9 : update
DB <.. UC10 : delete
DB <.. UC13 : query
DB <.. UC14 : insert
DB <.. UC15 : delete
DB <.. UC18 : insert bill

@enduml",
